title: 4chan whistleblower: orange-light orbs scan for minerals and biologics; abduction

tellings.quote: And he would go like if you see an orange light, it's they're scanning for minerals or biologics. And if if the orange light comes up to you, there's a likelihood that you've you're going to be abducted or you've been abducted.

plain: Glowing orange lights are probes scanning for minerals or living things, and one that comes up to you means you may be abducted or already have been, according to an anonymous poster on 4chan, an online message board where users don't give their names. A guest named Chris Ramsay repeats the claim to Michels from the poster's thread: "if you see an orange light, it's they're scanning for minerals or biologics." If true, it would make a common kind of sighting a sign of deliberate survey work, and of abductions.
